review_comments.body: **Missing-field filters lose rows** For a multi-row file, rewriting `s.y.is_null()` to `null_lit().is_null()` produces a one-element boolean array. `eval_predicate_mask` passes it unchanged to array filtering and `bool_array_to_row_selection`, so the selection covers only the first row instead of keeping every row. Expand constant masks to the batch length before using them, and add a multi-row read test. The new tests only check rewriting and binding.
